WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = S*C + L*(t_tx + t_prop) + S*t_sw + t_sync

variables_definition.S: number of switches (egress transmissions under CQF) along the path
variables_definition.L: number of links (hop_count) along the path

assumptions: Each switch adds exactly one CQF cycle of delay (store in cycle n, transmit in cycle n+1).
End stations are not adding CQF cycle delays; last delivery occurs after the last switch egress transmission.
Serialization time is counted per link; transmissions on different links occur in successive cycles (no overlap).
Time synchronization error is added once as an end-to-end margin.
All TT flows use PCP=7 and alternate between queue 7 (odd cycles) and queue 6 (even cycles).

missing_inputs: Exact Ethernet framing overhead (L2 header/VLAN tag, preamble, IFG) to refine serialization time; only payload size was provided.
Exact CQF transmit window sizes inside the 50 us cycle; some payloads exceed 50 us serialization at 100 Mbps, which may require multi-cycle transmission or different windowing assumptions.
Per-hop gate phase offsets (schedules) are not specified; worst-case per-hop wait taken as one full cycle.
Clarification whether time synchronization error should be applied per hop or end-to-end; applied once here as a conservative margin.
Confirmation whether source end-stations implement CQF gating; here CQF cycles are attributed to switch egresses only.

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD_us = S * C + L * (d_ser + d_prop) + S * d_sw + 2 * S * e

variables.S: number of switches on the path (equal to hop_count - 1)
variables.L: number of links (equal to hop_count from the route)
variables.d_ser: serialization time per link = 8 * payload_bytes / (link_rate_bits_per_us) = 0.08 * payload_bytes (us) at 100 Mb/s
variables.e: time synchronization error (us); 2e per switch for guard (ingress+egress)

notes: CQF (IEEE 802.1Qch) adds one cycle of store-and-forward per switch hop; with double buffering, each switch transmits a frame in the cycle after it was received.
Cut-through minimizes per-switch latency but does not change the per-hop CQF cycle carry.
Serialization, propagation, switching delays, and time sync margin are accumulated hop-by-hop.
Offset at source is set to 0 as requested; no additional source waiting time is added.

missing_inputs: Exact L2 overhead (headers, preamble, IFG) to add to payload for serialization time; payload-only used here.
Exact application of time sync error (whether 1e or 2e per hop); 2e per switch was assumed as a safe guard.
